headline: Fielder紀錄片直擊霍姆斯
context: 紐約影展最受矚目的一部片，是長達三小時的紀錄片《You Can See Everything》，喜劇演員奈森．菲爾德（Nathan Fielder）在片中直接訪問Theranos創辦人伊莉莎白．霍姆斯（Elizabeth Holmes）。菲爾德甚至搬進霍姆斯一家同住拍攝，影評形容這部片是「一部關於欺騙的現代傑作」。

sources.summary: The buzziest screening at the New York Film Festival is a three-hour documentary in which Nathan Fielder questions Elizabeth Holmes, the disgraced Theranos founder.
sources.title: ‘You Can See Everything,’ if You Could Only Secure a Ticket

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: No spoilers here – TV’s grand illusionist meets his match when he moves in with Theranos founder and her family For anyone remotely near the worlds of documentary, comedy or medical fraud, there has been one thing on the mind for weeks now: a single-minute clip of Nathan Fielder , the absurdist comedian whose boundary-pushing HBO series The Rehearsal cemented his status as docu-reality’s premier auteur, staring into the deep blue eyes of Elizabeth Holmes , the disgraced founder of the blood-testing startup Theranos. Unblinking, faces inches apart, the famously dry purveyor of harebrained business schemes and the convicted fraudster appeared locked in a battle of wills. “Are you being real right now?” Fielder asked her, in a classically meta bit – could Fielder really have spent years filming a secret documentary with one of Silicon Valley’s most notorious pariahs? The prospect of TV’s grand illusionist versus emblematic girl-boss scammer seemed potentially too good to be true; buzz for You Can See Everything, Fielder’s furtive documentary co-directed with wunderkind du jour Lance Oppenheim (whose narrative feature debut, the Robert Pattinson-starring Primetime , premiered last month) was such that access to the film’s New York film festival premiere on Wednesday became this fall’s hottest ticket . voice_text: 紐約影展今年最受矚目的一部片，是一支訪問伊莉莎白．霍姆斯的紀錄片。這支三小時的紀錄片裡，喜劇演員奈森．菲爾德直接訪問Theranos創辦人霍姆斯，甚至搬進她家中同住拍攝。有評論形容這部片是一部關於欺騙的現代傑作。
